title: Curried transport-event algebra separates operation effect from chedain sequence scope
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. A type-driven transport builder derives qok operation values and applies written cargo arguments, while the separate chedain component contributes sequence scope. qokeedy therefore remains CONVEY_OUT exactly; it does not hide NEXT. The model predicts when TAKE_OUT and CONVEY_OUT have the same physical transition and when a separate NEXT marker changes event ordering.

observations: Frozen GDT993 SPEC separates CONVEY_OUT, NEXT, and CargoRef into three ordered semantic atoms; RAW377 writes qokeedy chedain chedy in exactly that order.
GDT993 states that TAKE_OUT and CONVEY_OUT have identical transport truth conditions and that their different spellings remain unexplained lexical synonymy.
GDT608 supports directed formal component composition but retains exact whole residuals, so this card tests an explicitly typed application law rather than treating every whole as a macro.
IDEA000432 incorrectly folded NEXT into qokeedy; this card preserves that correction as its central changed input.

typed_values: qok creates a TransportBuilder with slots for direction, vehicle and cargo; it does not itself name a voyage.
o fills direction=OUT toward the paragraph's GoalBank slot when that slot is already introduced; k fills the vehicle/transport frame.
One e requests a CargoRef argument. A second e changes the builder's operation channel from reference to outward operation.

y closes a zero-e builder as FERRY or a two-e builder as TAKE_OUT; dy closes a one-e builder as the typed cargo reference G or a two-e builder as CONVEY_OUT. These are typed closures, not occurrence-specific whole aliases.
a opens the Agent-plus-Cargo joint argument channel and l closes it as TRAVEL_TOGETHER.
chedain is an independent sequence function: NEXT(event, prior_event_state) schedules the supplied event after the prior actual voyage. It is never consumed inside qokeedy.
application_order: Reduce qok/o/k and suffixes into a typed builder.
Apply the immediately following written CargoRef or Agent/Cargo arguments; an absent required argument is undefined rather than guessed.
Apply chedain only after its preceding event and before its following CargoRef-bearing event, preserving its own word boundary.
Update the transport state only after the completed event is applied; operation naming and sequence ordering are separate semantic fields.
worked_outputs: qokeey(qokedy) = TAKE_OUT(G), producing one outbound event.
qokeedy chedain chedy = NEXT(CONVEY_OUT(C), prior_event), where qokeedy alone is CONVEY_OUT and chedain alone is NEXT.
qoky(FIRST_CARGO) = FERRY(FIRST_CARGO), with destination opposite the current bank.
qokedy = CargoRef(G) and chedy = CargoRef(C) remain reusable typed arguments, not operations.
mechanism.rival: The frozen synonym-only rival treats TAKE_OUT and CONVEY_OUT as independently named operations with no shared effect law; the 432-style rival additionally treats qokeedy as a hidden NEXT-bearing macro.
mechanism.content_consequence: On the retained S05 and S13 clauses, both qokeey(qokedy) and qokeedy(chedy) produce one outbound transport transition, but only S13 has the explicit chedain sequence relation. A future complete clause containing qokeedy without chedain must still produce a legal CONVEY_OUT event, while a future qokeedy chedain X must be ordered after the previous actual event. This distinguishes operation effect from sequence scope and predicts a different event-order trace from the hidden-NEXT rival.

design.falsifier: Reject the algebra if a frozen complete occurrence requires qokeedy itself to carry NEXT, if chedain changes no event order where a prior and following voyage are explicit, if qokeey and qokeedy have different physical transitions with identical typed arguments and no written trigger, or if a same typed builder needs an occurrence-specific output. Missing arguments must remain undefined; no local repair is allowed.
design.strongest_failure: The operation equivalence is inherited from GDT993's stipulated truth conditions, not independently observed. The component segmentation and builder states remain hypotheses, and no complete target passage independently binds an event-order relation to chedain. The model may simply redistribute old whole labels across a convenient type system.

predecessors.limit: Conditional transport truth conditions; no independent operation identity.
Corrects its qokeedy/NEXT conflation; retains its exact raw bytes unchanged.
Whole transport predecessor without a component-level sequence/effect split.
Nested operation evaluation is a different inside-out record model; this card separates two independent word-level fields and does not add nested result operations.

dependencies: Frozen ZL3b forms and SPEC atoms remain unchanged; IT2a/RF1b are not pooled as independent witnesses.
GoalBank, vehicle, agent, and cargo identities remain inherited typed variables, not confirmed target meanings.
No qokeedy whole-form NEXT value, Latin default, or new target access is allowed.
A future discriminator requires a complete already exposed clause with explicit before/after event structure.
design.access: GDT993 REPORT/SPEC, RAW377 complete lexicon, GDT608, bounded IDEA432 audit and duplicate checks only; no target data/image, reserve, root experiment, decoder, route, ledger, or source mutation.
